description: Implementation of a message transmitter class for handling Ethernet frame bursts, message enqueueing, and symbol-based transmission timing in a network communication system.

classes.name: message_transmitter_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a message transmitter handling Ethernet frame bursts and timing for network communication.

methods.name: transmit_frame_burst
methods.description: Sends a burst of Ethernet frames.

methods.name: enqueue_messages_into_burst
methods.description: Enqueues pending messages into a burst for transmission based on timing intervals.

methods.name: on_new_symbol
methods.description: Handles new symbol events, enqueues control and user plane messages, and transmits the burst.

methods.name: get_ethernet_transmitter
methods.description: Returns a reference to the Ethernet transmitter object.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns a reference to the metrics collector.
